body.statement: For \(c=(1/3,2/3,-1/4,-3/4)\), exact primal and dual response-alphabet witnesses over all sixteen \(t\in\mathcal T_c\) give \(\kappa(c)=11/36\). The basis \(B=[v,d_1,d_2,d_3]\), with \(d_j\in\ker(c^\top)\), represents every missing-active-arm target direction, and adding an inactive fifth arm changes the allocation identity to \[H(q)-4=4\sum_{a\in S_c}(q_a-q_a^\star)^2/q_a+4\left(1-\sum_{a\in S_c}q_a\right).\]
body.justification: This exact mixed-sign case is the earliest falsification test for the universal coefficient and every allocation-face identity.
body.gap: The finite checks in the presolve draft are not an asymptotic or design-uniform theorem and have not appeared in the cited literature.
body.consumer: A failed identity here terminates the universal program before costly weak-integration and certificate work.
